description: Byte-preserved original six-seed outer postprocessing source. Numerical data and reports are not included in this source-only upload.
scope: Seeds42-47;1139 classification records; all target accuracies. Paired architecture-group bootstrap stratified by outer fold,10000 draws,seed0,Bonferroni5. Fixed models and selections; no model refitting or seed resampling.
usage_boundary: These originals retain their historical Windows input/output paths. Inspect and configure paths before executing elsewhere. The renderer executes at import and refuses an existing report. They are not automatically executed by run_all.py. The portable revision modes are documented separately in docs/REVISION_WORKFLOWS.md.
verification: Original analysis and rendering were executed on the exported data before publication. Copies byte-compared with those originals and syntax checked. No GPU Jobs or cleanup were performed during publication.
